column1: # The error codes this API can return. One row per code:  code <TAB> HTTP status <TAB> message
# scripts/error-codes.sh checks this file and writes the source files named by the @emit lines.
#   - Add a row. Never rename or delete one and never change its status: clients branch on both.
#     A code that is no longer returned gets the word "deprecated" in a fourth column.
#   - The first thirteen rows are the same in every RantAI repository. Leave them as they are.
#   - A code is lower snake_case. Add one only when a client would act differently on it;
#     otherwise use a base code and say what happened in the message.
#   - The message is the default text for the code: a full sentence, no internal detail.
